headline: Former Brazilian Football Star Ronaldinho Returns To Professional Play
seoTitle: Ronaldinho Returns To Pro Football At 46
metaDescription: Brazilian football legend Ronaldinho has returned to the pitch at 46 years old, playing for Italian third-tier club Ravenna in a derby victory.
aiSummaryBullets: Ronaldinho returned to professional competition at age 46 for the Italian club Ravenna.
The player participated in the first half of a third-tier league derby against Forli.
Ravenna secured a 2-0 victory with Ronaldinho contributing to the performance after becoming a club stakeholder.
aiContextParagraph: Ronaldinho, the former Brazilian international and global football star, has officially returned to professional competition 11 years after his initial retirement. At 46 years old, the athlete took the field for the Italian club Ravenna during a Serie C derby match against Forli. According to reports, Ronaldinho played the entirety of the first half and participated in the lead-up to a goal, contributing to Ravenna's eventual 2-0 win. This appearance follows his recent decision to become a partner and stakeholder in the Italian club. The match marks a notable return to official league play for the former FIFA World Player of the Year, who had previously stepped away from the professional game over a decade ago. His participation in the Italian third division has drawn attention due to his status as a decorated former national team player.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained traction due to the high profile of the athlete involved, reflected by coverage from international and Brazilian media outlets.
